# pangolin_ai_catalog_models (Data Source)

Lists the upstream model keys that Pangolin's built-in catalog knows for an AI provider type. Useful to pick the `model_key` of a `pangolin_ai_model`. The catalog may be empty for the `custom` type.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Model keys Pangolin suggests for Anthropic providers.
data "pangolin_ai_catalog_models" "anthropic" {
  type  = "anthropic"
  query = "sonnet"
}

output "anthropic_sonnet_keys" {
  value = data.pangolin_ai_catalog_models.anthropic.model_keys
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `type` (String) The provider type: `openai`, `anthropic`, `googleGemini`, `vertexAi`, `bedrock`, `microsoftFoundry`, `openRouter`, `vercelAiGateway` or `custom`.

### Optional

- `query` (String) Only return model keys containing this text.

### Read-Only

- `model_keys` (List of String) The catalog model keys.
